bones_groups.description: Observed only rarely, and empty in every sample seen. Presumably Vitruvian Bones (a Moho Pro 13.5 feature - animatable per-group 'which bone is active' switching, like a SwitchLayer scoped to a subset of one skeleton's bones) - matched at the MECHANISM level by Moho's own scripting API, M_Skeleton::CountGroups()/Group(id) returning M_BoneGroup {name, AnimVal fActiveBone, bool fEnabled}, though not confirmed as the same field at the serialization level. See docs/moho-rigging-and-deformation.md section 4b. Read by moho2svg.py only to WARN when non-empty (Skeleton.bones_groups); the groups themselves are not parsed or applied.

active_bone.description: Which member bone is currently active, as an animatable index into `bones` (Moho's own scripting header names the equivalent member M_BoneGroup::fActiveBone, an AnimVal). Never read by moho2svg.py, only warned about (walk_render_tree warns once per BoneLayer with a non-empty bones_groups) - see bones_groups above. This is the Vitruvian Bones selector, already substantially decoded in docs/moho-rigging-and-deformation.md §4b/4b.1: 0-based into the group's own `bones` list, an out-of-range value falls back to the first member, and a hand-authored 2-member test group on TransformBoneTool.animeproj measured Moho's own render changing 2,840 px for one member vs ~22 px (anti-alias noise) for the other three tried indices - confirming a real effect while explicitly leaving the SEMANTICS unresolved (the natural "inactive members go inert" model was implemented and measured wrong: an inactive sibling is not switched off, and where both do change the model covers only 33% of Moho's changed pixels). M1.5 registers that finding formally: the only corpus instance (Night_Boy.mohoproj, one BoneGroup of 3 bones, `bones: [101, 102, 103]`) already keyframes it (val 2.0 at frame 0, 0.0 from frame 1); forcing the channel to a third, untried index (1.0) via tools/probe_field.py also changed the frame-0 render (docs/moho-field-probes.md, 1 site, AFFECTS RENDER) - a second, independent confirmation on a different document. EDITABLE reflects the confirmed render effect; do not read this as a semantics decode, which docs/moho-rigging-and-deformation.md §4b.1 explicitly says remains open.
active_bone.x-moho-evidence: docs/moho-field-probes.md: active_bone forced to 1.0, 1 site, Night_Boy.mohoproj frame 0, AFFECTS RENDER; see also docs/moho-rigging-and-deformation.md §4b.1 (2,840px hand-authored-group measurement, semantics still open)

Bone.description: One bone. A flat list (Skeleton.bones) - `parent` is an index into the SAME list, not a tree. Parents are not guaranteed to appear earlier in the list than their children. Every constraint/IK/physics/control field below (angle_control_*, pos_control_*, scale_control_*, ik_*, min/max_constraint, and every *_dynamics/*_force/physics_* field) is read by moho2svg.py in the sense that the document model exposes it, but NOT applied when rendering - see docs/moho-project-file-format.md §9 KNOWN GAPS. They matter only for posing live in the Moho editor; the resulting angle/position is already baked into anim_angle/anim_pos by the time the document is saved, EXCEPT for anim_parent, which can genuinely diverge from the static `parent` field (see below).

anim_parent.description: Animated reparenting: the value at each keyframe is a bone INDEX (or -1), letting a bone change parent mid-animation (the Reparent Bone tool). moho2svg.py uses the static `parent` field instead and ignores this. **M1.5 correction (2026-08-19): the old "confirmed harmless" claim here was wrong** - it was based on a sample that never included a document keyframing an actual mid-animation reparent. A full 76-document/5,196-channel corpus scan (replacing the stale 19-file/850-channel figure) found 7 bones across 5 documents (Snow-girl-cut12/13/51.mohoproj, Snow_wars/02 snow fight.moho, Snow_wars/04 snow man construction.moho) whose anim_parent channel genuinely has a second keyframe diverging from the bone's own static `parent` - e.g. Snow-girl-cut12 bone B33: static parent -1, anim_parent -1.0 at frame 0 then 6.0 from frame 69 on. Isolated single-bone probe (tools/probe_field.py against a hand-built fixture holding only that one bone's anim_parent under its real name, every other bone's occurrence renamed out of the way) confirms Moho's own renderer honours the divergence: forcing bone B33's channel back to a constant -1.0 changes the frame-90 render (docs/moho-field-probes.md). So moho2svg.py's ignore-it approach is a REAL, currently-shipping rendering defect on these 5 documents past their reparent frame, not merely a theoretical risk - recorded here, not fixed (out of scope for the field-coverage registry).
anim_parent.x-moho-evidence: docs/moho-field-probes.md: anim_parent forced to a constant, 1 site (hand-isolated fixture, see description), Snow-girl-cut12.mohoproj-derived fixture frame 90, AFFECTS RENDER
